sections.headline: BongoRx: EPAP Sleep Apnea Therapy Without the Machine
sections.lead: A simple, portable CPAP alternative for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea patients who want freedom from machines, hoses, and power.
checklist: Prescription cash product — great for retail, FSA/HSA customers, and CPAP alternative inquiries.
Travel-friendly therapy — no machine, hose, or electricity required.
Built-in replenishment — the Starter Kit opens the door to recurring annual and single replacement sales.

sections.title: A New Cash Sales Opportunity for Sleep Therapy Customers
sections.intro: BongoRx gives dealers a compact, clinically tested, FDA-cleared sleep apnea therapy option for patients with mild to moderate OSA who may not want, tolerate, or afford a traditional CPAP setup.

items.name: Ideal Patient Profile
items.description: Newly diagnosed mild to moderate OSA patients, CPAP non-compliant patients, travelers, and patients facing high deductibles or co-payments.

items.name: No Power Required
items.description: Uses the patient’s own exhalation to create EPAP, helping keep the airway open without a machine or electricity.

items.name: Simple Starter Kit
items.description: The Four Sizes Starter Kit allows easy contactless setup with multiple sizes, headgear, travel case, and drying stand.

sections.headline: Small, simple, and built for real-world use.
sections.copy: BongoRx has soft nasal seals that dilate the nasal passages. During inhalation, small valves open so the patient can breathe normally. During exhalation, valves close and direct air through vent holes to generate EPAP.
checklist: Clinically tested for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea
FDA-cleared CPAP alternative with history of use
Use at home, traveling, camping, or when electricity is unavailable
No assembly required and easy to clean
